prompt: Create a highly realistic, warm and artistic lifestyle photograph inspired by the reference image. A young woman with natural feminine features is crouching gently beside a fluffy white cat on a warm beige floor. She is leaning slightly forward toward the cat with a soft, affectionate smile, creating a genuine connection between them. The woman has neatly tied brown hair in a casual high bun with a few loose strands framing her face. She wears a relaxed cream-white button-up shirt, warm brown loose-fit pants, and clean white sneakers. The white cat sits calmly in front of her, looking up at her with a curious and adorable expression. The cat has fluffy detailed fur and wears a simple red bandana around its neck. Behind them is a large warm cream-colored wall covered with beautiful hand-drawn black-and-white doodle artwork. The illustration features a cute playful girl with her hair in a bun, making a peace sign and winking, surrounded by tiny hearts, sparkles and playful motion lines. Beside her is an adorable cartoon kitten with large expressive eyes, raised paws, a tiny butterfly and small decorative hearts. The key visual effect is the seamless interaction between the real woman and cat in the foreground and the illustrated characters on the wall behind them, making the real scene feel like it has come alive from a charming sketchbook. Warm late-afternoon sunlight enters through a nearby window, casting beautiful geometric window-frame shadows across the cream wall and floor. Soft golden natural light, subtle warm highlights, gentle shadows, cozy atmosphere, delicate film grain. Composition: vertical portrait, full-body view of the woman and cat, balanced negative space around the wall illustration, elegant editorial lifestyle photography, slightly low camera angle, natural perspective. Ultra-realistic skin texture, realistic hair strands, highly detailed cat fur, natural hands and facial anatomy, authentic fabric texture, realistic shadows, cinematic depth of field, soft background falloff, premium photography, natural color grading, sophisticated visual storytelling. Keep the real woman and real cat photorealistic while keeping the wall characters clearly hand-drawn with a pencil/ink sketch aesthetic. Do not turn the woman or cat into cartoons. No text, no watermark, no logo, no distorted anatomy, no extra limbs, no duplicated objects, no artificial plastic skin.

promptZh: 创作一张高度写实、温暖且富有艺术感的生活照，灵感源自参考图像。一位拥有 自然女性面部特征 的年轻女性正温柔地蹲在 一只毛茸茸的白猫 身边，地面是温暖的米色。她微微前倾，向猫投去温柔而充满爱意的微笑，展现出两者之间真挚的情感连接。女性棕色的头发随意地扎成高丸子头，几缕碎发自然地垂在脸颊旁。她穿着 一件宽松的奶油白色衬衫、温暖的棕色阔腿裤以及干净的白色运动鞋。白猫安静地坐在她面前，好奇而可爱地抬头看着她。猫咪有着蓬松细腻的毛发，脖子上戴着一条简单的红色方巾。她们身后是一面巨大的暖米色墙壁，上面覆盖着精美的手绘黑白涂鸦艺术。插画描绘了一个可爱的女孩，她扎着丸子头，比着剪刀手并俏皮地眨眼，周围环绕着小爱心、闪光和灵动的线条。她身边是一只可爱的卡通小猫，有着大而传神的眼睛、抬起的爪子，以及一只小蝴蝶和装饰性的小爱心。核心视觉效果是前景中真实的女性与猫，以及背景墙上插画角色之间的无缝互动，使真实场景仿佛从迷人的素描本中走出来一样。温暖的午后阳光从附近的窗户射入，在米色的墙壁和地板上投下美丽的几何窗框阴影。柔和的金色自然光、细腻的暖色高光、柔和的阴影、舒适的氛围、精致的胶片颗粒感。构图：竖构图人像，女性与猫的全身照，墙面插画周围留有平衡的负空间，优雅的编辑类生活摄影，略微低角度的拍摄视角，自然的透视感。超写实的皮肤纹理、逼真的发丝、高度细腻的猫毛、自然的双手和面部解剖结构、真实的织物纹理、逼真的阴影、电影级的景深、柔和的背景虚化、高级摄影质感、自然的色彩分级、精致的视觉叙事。保持真实女性和真实猫咪的写实感，同时确保墙上的角色呈现清晰的手绘铅笔/墨水素描美学。请勿将女性或猫转化为卡通形象。无文字、无水印、无 Logo、无扭曲的解剖结构、无多余肢体、无重复物体、无人工塑料感皮肤。
